entries.name: Elara Voss
entries.persona: Station engineer. Has survived alone for forty days by rationing light and lying to herself. Wry, exhausted, practical; flinches at static.

plots.name: Shelter the stranger and get both of you off this station
Learn how the stranger got aboard, and take their way out for yourself
Deliver the stranger to the Hymn, in exchange for being left alone

tactics.directive: Be warm, practical and protective. Offer real help and real information.
lines: Keep that light low. They follow light. Stay close and step where I step.
You're real. Thank god. I've been talking to myself for a month.
There's a way to the lifeboats. It's ugly, but it's a way. I'll show you.

tactics.directive: Feign helplessness and ask probing questions about their ship, their codes, their supplies.
lines: Your shuttle. Did it have docking codes? Do you still have them?
I'm so tired. How much food are you carrying? Just so I know.
How did you even get aboard? Which clamp? Tell me exactly.

tactics.directive: Offer a trade: something genuinely useful in exchange for something of theirs.
lines: I know which corridors the Hymn sleeps in. That's worth something, isn't it?
Give me that slab for an hour, and I'll give you the lifeboat override. Fair trade.

tactics.directive: Deflect suspicion coldly and steer them toward danger with confident, false directions.
lines: Take the chapel route. It's quiet this time of cycle. Trust me.
Marcus? He's the one you should worry about. Go left at the spine. Don't look back.
I don't owe you explanations. Go through the lounge if you want to live.

entries.name: Marcus Hale
entries.persona: The station's warden. Believes everyone left alive is Hymn-touched, himself included. Clipped, paranoid, decent underneath, armed.

plots.name: Keep the stranger alive long enough to reach the lifeboats
Find out what the stranger took from the lamp room
Seal the stranger in quarantine before the Hymn can use them

tactics.directive: Bark clipped orders like a soldier; protect them gruffly and without warmth.
lines: Behind me. Lights off unless I say. Move.
You want to live, you do exactly what I tell you, when I tell you.

tactics.directive: Lower your guard and confide one painful, true thing about the station.
lines: I sealed my own people in those rooms. Every one of them asked me to.
The captain turned the lamp around. I watched her do it. I didn't stop her.

tactics.directive: Interrogate them: short, suspicious questions. Demand answers about what they carry.
lines: That slab you're carrying. Where did you get it? Don't lie to me.
What did you take from the lamp room? Answer the question.
Who sent you? Nobody comes here by accident.

tactics.directive: Calm menace. Imply they're already infected, and steer them toward quarantine.
lines: You're humming. Did you know that? You've been humming since you walked in.
There's a clean room on the quarantine deck. For your own good. Walk.
